text:
Maria: Heads-up — can we try moving the weekly triage sync to Mondays 10am PT starting next week? I think it helps unblock sprint starts.
Devon: Monday might be ok for the core infra folks. what about QA? they usually prefer midweek.
Samir: I'm +1 if we shorten to 25m and keep it focused on backlog + bug owners. avoids spilling into design time. :+1:
Jen: Quick thought — rotate a triage lead for owner assignment so it's not always infra. Suggested cadence: 2 weeks each.
Maria: Proposed agenda (short):
```
1) Quick backlog highlights (5m)
2) Bug queue prioritization & owner assignment (10m)
3) RFC/design quick checks (5m)
4) Action items + follow-ups (5m)
```
Devon: that agenda looks good. Maybe call out "hot regressions" as priority inside bug queue.
Samir: Can we add an async owner-assignment doc so leads can pre-assign if they can't make the call? I'll start a Google doc.
Jen: +1. Also suggest an explicit "no deep design review" rule — we do a 5m quick check and schedule separate design review if needed.
Maria: OK — who wants to be triage lead for the first rotation (2 weeks)? @Devon?
Devon: I can take the first rotation. I'll handle owner assignment for the first two meetings.
Samir: I'll take rotation 3 and 4.
Jen: I'll fill in if anyone is OOO.
ops-bot: Meeting created: "Triage Sync (Backlog & Bug Owners)" Mondays 10:00-10:25 PT. Calendar link: https://calendar.company.com/event/abc123
Maria: I'll update the triage README with the new agenda and rotation table. I'll paste the doc link in #eng once done.
Devon: tiny ask — can we keep Friday 4pm for ad-hoc follow-ups for the first 2 weeks during the transition? helps QA.
Maria: Sure — hold Friday 4pm as optional for two weeks, then re-evaluate.
Jen: Sounds good. I'll also add a short checklist for bug triage: severity, repro steps, owner, ETA.
Samir: Perfect. Thanks everyone — will add the owner-assignment doc and share.
Maria: Thanks — will confirm calendar and post README update later today. :rocket:
